regions.name: explorer1
regions.rationale: Focuses on speed with minimal seed specificity, using shorter seeds and lower cap values to reduce computational overhead while maintaining reasonable sensitivity.

regions.name: explorer2
regions.rationale: Balances speed and sensitivity by using moderate seed lengths and cap values, with slightly more gap exploration for better alignment coverage.

regions.name: explorer3
regions.rationale: Prioritizes sensitivity over speed with longer seeds and higher cap values, allowing for more comprehensive seed exploration while maintaining reasonable performance.
